facts.text: Cheval Blanc Paris is located in the heart of historic Paris, in front of the Pont-Neuf, between the Louvre and Le Marais.
facts.excerpt: Cheval Blanc Paris is located at the heart of historic Paris, in front of the Pont-Neuf, between Le Louvre and Le Marais.

facts.text: The hotel, its restaurants and the Dior Spa Cheval Blanc are accessible to people with reduced mobility.
facts.excerpt: The Maison, its restaurants and the Dior Spa Cheval Blanc are accessible to people with reduced mobility.

facts.text: The hotel sits within La Samaritaine, Henri Sauvage's 1928 Art Deco building and a designated historic site.
facts.excerpt: the Paris Maison sits within Henri Sauvage's 1928 Art Déco masterpiece, La Samaritaine, a designated historic site

facts.text: This section of La Samaritaine was restored and reworked into a hotel over five years, opening in fall 2021.
facts.excerpt: This section of the building was meticulously restored and reworked into a hotel over the course of five years, opening in fall 2021.

facts.text: In 2026 France's Ministry of Tourism awarded Cheval Blanc Paris the Palace distinction.
facts.excerpt: In 2026, Cheval Blanc Paris was awarded “Palace” distinction by France’s Ministry of Tourism

facts.text: Architect Peter Marino reworked the interiors, his first hotel project.
facts.excerpt: architect Peter Marino, who reworked the interiors in his first hotel project

facts.text: The art in the shared spaces includes a Frank Gehry horse sculpture specially commissioned for the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Pieces include a Frank Gehry horse sculpture (specially commissioned for the Maison)

facts.text: More than half of the rooms and suites have views of the River Seine; others look out at Parisian facades or the Louvre.
facts.excerpt: more than half offer views of the River Seine (others look out at Parisian façades or the Louvre)

facts.text: Each guest has a dedicated butler during the stay.
facts.excerpt: your dedicated butler, trained to anticipate your desires, can accommodate during your stay

facts.text: The bathroom amenities line was commissioned from Francois Demachy, Christian Dior's longtime in-house perfumer.
facts.excerpt: an amenities line commissioned from François Demachy, Christian Dior's longtime in-house perfumer

facts.text: L'Appartement occupies the 8th and 9th floors and has its own swimming pool, seven bedrooms and a panoramic terrace.
facts.excerpt: It has its own 40-foot-long swimming pool, a wellness area and a projection room, seven bedrooms, a panoramic terrace

facts.text: The Dior Spa pool was designed by Peter Marino, under a mirrored ceiling and surrounded by handcrafted mosaics by Michael Mayer.
facts.excerpt: designed by architect Peter Marino, situated under a mirrored ceiling, and surrounded by handcrafted mosaics by Michael Mayer

facts.text: The spa has six Dior treatment suites, a marble-clad hammam, a sauna, a cold plunge and a snow shower.
facts.excerpt: there are six Dior treatment suites, a marble-clad hammam, a sauna, cold plunge, and snow shower

facts.text: The spa floor also has a 24/7 gym and a Rossano Ferretti hair salon.
facts.excerpt: Also on this floor: the 24/7 gym, complete the chicest Dior yoga mats, plus a Rossano Ferretti hair salon.

facts.text: Chef Arnaud Donckele and pastry chef Maxime Frederic lead the restaurants Plenitude, Hakuba and Le Tout-Paris.
facts.excerpt: Plénitude (French fare, three stars), Hakuba (Japanese, two stars), and Le Tout-Paris (French brasserie, one star). Led by chef Arnaud Donckele and pastry chef Maxime Frédéric, these venues

facts.text: Three of the restaurants hold six Michelin stars between them, including three stars for Plenitude.
facts.excerpt: six Michelin Stars, awarded to three of its onsite restaurants: Plénitude (French fare, three stars)

facts.text: Breakfast can be taken at an outdoor table with views of the Seine and the Eiffel Tower.
facts.excerpt: Request an outdoor table at breakfast if the weather is nice—the Seine and Eiffel Tower views more than warrant it.

facts.text: Guests can take a boat cruise on the Seine in a Cheval Blanc-chartered boat, accompanied by hotel staff with snacks, sweet treats and bubbles.
facts.excerpt: a boat cruise on the Seine in a Cheval Blanc–chartered boat; hotel staff will accompany you with snacks, sweet treats, and bubbles

facts.text: The complimentary Le Carrousel kids club offers daily activities for guests up to 12.
facts.excerpt: the complementary Le Carrousel kids club offers daily activities for guests up to 12

facts.text: Notre Dame is a 15-minute walk away and the Louvre is 5 minutes from the front door.
facts.excerpt: Notre Dame is a 15-minute walk away on the Ile de la Cité, while the Louvre is just 5 minutes from the front door

facts.text: The Louis Vuitton Cafe is next door to the hotel.
facts.excerpt: a visit to the Louis Vuitton Café next door is in order

facts.text: It is one of six Cheval Blanc hotels and the brand's one city-based hotel.
facts.excerpt: This is one of six Cheval Blancs around the world, and the only city-based one.

facts.text: From a Seine Junior Suite, the Eiffel Tower can be seen glittering at night from an indoor balcony with floor-to-ceiling bay windows.
facts.excerpt: From my Seine Junior Suite, I could sit and watch the Eiffel Tower glittering at night from a sort of solarium-style indoor balcony, replete with floor-to-ceiling bay windows.

facts.text: The spa pool is surrounded by large-scale digital screens that create the effect of looking out at the Seine and the Paris skyline.
facts.excerpt: large-scale digital screens creating the effect of looking out at the Seine and Paris’s skyline
